## TDS Follow-up Inbox Sync
Called by the **TDS Credit Reconciliation Assistant** (Follow-ups tab â Sync inbox).

- Finds sent mails and replies whose subject carries **[Ref TDS/PAN/TAN/FY]**
- Returns sender, date, reply text (quoted history removed) and PDF attachments
- Nothing is stored in n8n

**Outlook:** connect a Microsoft Outlook credential on *Search Outlook*, then enable the node.
**Security:** requests without the private key are ignored (Webhook â Only run if).
